Documentation is a test suite nobody grades

admitted.what_is_kept: call the callable the example exercised, on sentences the example never showed
the property the docstring states: the median of data is the middle of its sorted form

admission_requires: an example matched the guide's printed output
every mutation of that example was separated
the rule held on an input the guide never showed
kept.why_this_is_not_a_cache: a matched example is a transcription of one answer; a rule kept here is the callable plus the property that let it be checked on inputs no guide contains

seam.the_seam: a transcript can be checked by replaying it; a prose sentence about the environment cannot be checked by any example, and this round does not pretend to read it

what_this_is_not: not a benchmark result: one machine, four guides, no OSWorld, no FrontierSWE, no Terminal-Bench
not evidence that the system reads arbitrary documentation: the extractor handles fenced transcripts with $ or >>> prompts and nothing else

not evidence of instant learning: the transfer tasks are two, chosen because the documentation states their property, and the rule comes from a module the example named rather than from the example's text
not a memory design: the store is a JSON list of admitted rules and refusals, written to show that three tests can refuse something, not to persist a capability
limits: the guides were fetched while building, so 'no network at run time' is a property of this instrument and not of the machine that fetched them
a guide's printed output is version-matched only when the guide and the library are the same version; neither is pinned here
the decoy mutation edits literals in the example's own statement, so an example with no literal cannot be probed and is reported as such rather than assumed blind
